1.1.title: Text Alternatives
1.1.description: Provide text alternatives for non-text content.

1.2.title: Time-based Media
1.2.description: Provide captions and other alternatives for multimedia.

1.3.title: Adaptable
1.3.description: Create content that can be presented in different ways, including by assistive technologies, without losing meaning.

1.4.title: Distinguishable
1.4.description: Make it easier for users to see and hear content.

2.1.title: Keyboard Accessible
2.1.description: Make all functionality available from a keyboard.

2.2.title: Enough Time
2.2.description: Give users enough time to read and use content.

2.3.title: Seizures and Physical Reactions
2.3.description: Do not use content that causes seizures or physical reactions.

2.4.title: Navigable
2.4.description: Help users navigate and find content.

2.5.title: Input Modalities
2.5.description: Make it easier to use inputs other than keyboard.

3.2.title: Predictable
3.2.description: Make content appear and operate in predictable ways.

3.3.title: Input Assistance
3.3.description: Help users avoid and correct mistakes.

4.title: Robust
4.description: Can machines (browsers, screen readers, etc.) read the code?

4.1.title: Compatible
4.1.description: Maximize compatibility with current and future user tools.
